subject: KMS/HSM handover and rotation Q&A with BluePeak Security
messages:
From: Emma Carter <emma.carter@bluepeak.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: KMS/HSM artifacts for SIG/CAIQ submission

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this. We're finalizing our SIG/CAIQ for an internal audit and need a focused package of encryption and key management artifacts from Redwood for evaluation by our security team. Specifically we need:

- Key custody model and who has administrative access (roles & separation)
- HSM attestation for any customer-facing BYOK/Private deployment options
- Rotation schedule and past rotation evidence for the last 8 months
- Transport (TLS) cert chain details and any mTLS usage for internal control plane comms
- Evidence of access logging for KMS administrative actions

Can you confirm what you can provide, and whether you can share a single archive with the items listed? Our deadline for the SIG intake is EOD Friday, 2028-03-24.

Thanks,
Emma Carter
Head of Security Engineering
BluePeak Financial

----
Note: sending to grace_oconnor mailbox per our contact at Redwood.

From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Carter <emma.carter@bluepeak.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-22T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: KMS/HSM artifacts for SIG/CAIQ submission

Emma —

Appreciate the clear list. We can assemble a focused pack that covers all of those bullets. High level:

- Custody & roles: we'll include a KMS access matrix (CSV) showing which Redwood roles can perform administrative, cryptographic, and emergency unseal actions.
- HSM attestation: for private/BYOK deployments we have a provider attestation PDF; for hosted keys we will include provider attest artifacts and our own HSM integration notes.
- Rotation evidence: we'll attach rotation logs for the past 8 months plus a short narrative of our rotation policy and automation (rotation cadence, canary verification).
- Transport: cert chain + config snippets for control plane and customer-facing TLS endpoints.
- Logs: admin KMS action logs (redacted where necessary) and where those logs are retained.

Vivek will attach the attestation and logs; Rishi will confirm any contract/SLAs language we should highlight for your reviewer. Is the EOD Friday (24th) deadline firm? We can make that, but if reviewers need deeper sampling (e.g., multi-day rotation traces) let us know now.

I'll prepare a single zip and share a Drive link and a manifest of included files.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Emma —

Quick note from the contract side: for Private deployments where customers bring their own key material we typically provide the HSM attestation and integration notes; custody and access controls are in the customer's remit. For hosted customers we maintain per-tenant separation and can provide role mappings and restricted admin logs. If you want verbiage we can highlight for the SIG, we can include suggested answers that map to the SIG control IDs.

Also: rotation cadence we follow as standard is 90 days for data encryption keys (DEKs) and 12 months for master wrapping keys unless the customer requests otherwise. We'll include a short statement and the automated runbook we use for rotations.

I'll be available if BluePeak legal wants to discuss SLA language or an addendum for key custody.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Carter <emma.carter@bluepeak.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-23T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM handover and rotation Q&A — artifacts attached

Emma —

Attached is a consolidated archive with the items Grace outlined. Summary of what's included (see manifest in the archive and Drive link below):

1) redwood_kms-access-matrix.csv — maps Redwood roles to KMS capabilities (Admin, CryptoOps, Emergency, Read-only). Internal admin operations require multi-person approval for private deployments (RBAC + approval queue).

2) hsm-attestation-2028-03.pdf — vendor-signed attestation for the HSM module used for Redwood Private BYOK (FIPS 140-2 Level 3 equivalent). The attestation covers firmware version and measured boot state at the time of signing.

3) rotation-logs-2027-07_to_2028-03.zip — rotation events for master keys and DEK rewrap operations. Logs are redacted to remove customer identifiers per our policy; we include event IDs, timestamps, actor role, and audit hashes so you can verify continuity.

4) transport-layer-cert-chain.txt — full certificate chain and fingerprints for control plane TLS endpoints; notes on our mTLS usage for internal control plane traffic and where mutual auth is applied (private deployments between control plane and customer gateways).

5) admin-audit-sample.txt (in archive) — sample of admin actions (read-only subset), showing the KMS API calls, principal, and justification field.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/s/crypto-evidence/bluepeak (link expires 30 days)

Notes on procedures: our automated rotation pipeline performs staging, automated canary decrypts against a sample corpus, and rollback is automated if canary fails. Master wrapping keys are rotated with an HSM-backed key-derive process; we never export raw master key material.

If you need full, unredacted logs for a bounded audit window under NDA, we can discuss the workflow and a read-only access mechanism.

Attachments included: hsm-attestation-2028-03.pdf (31KB), rotation-logs-2027-07_to_2028-03.zip (4.8MB), redwood_kms-access-matrix.csv (4KB), transport-layer-cert-chain.txt (1KB)

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Crypto & Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: KMS/HSM handover and rotation Q&A — artifacts attached

Grace / Vivek / Rishi —

Received the bundle and the Drive link — thank you. The manifest and rotation logs look sufficient for our SIG intake. A few quick follow-ups our reviewer asked for before we close the ticket:

- Can you confirm whether rotation events include a cryptographic proof/hash chain we can verify? The sample shows audit hashes but we'd like the compute/hash algorithm noted in the manifest.
- For the HSM attestation PDF: can you include the attestation serial and firmware build number in plain text in the manifest (some reviewers want to reference those fields inline rather than in a PDF).
- Please confirm retention windows for admin KMS logs (how long are these logs stored and where).

If you can drop short answers to those three items into the manifest and re-upload, we should be able to close out the SIG collection. If anything requires an NDA or additional paperwork, flag it and we'll escalate.

Thanks again — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Emma Carter
Head of Security Engineering
BluePeak Financial
